Fundamental investing in Iran’s stock market with Codal, using Dr. Bardia Khosravani’s FIS method, plus investor psychology and personal finance (FLM), in short lessons and daily practice.
A mastery test for every hall
Each lesson takes a few minutes. Finish it without mistakes to earn 3 stars and a foil card.
Correct answers in a row give bonus XP and raise your level.
After each lesson you open a chest; sometimes it holds a “Golden hour” with double XP.
“60-second Blitz”: every correct answer adds time. Beat your own record.

This app is educational and is not investment advice. No method guarantees a profit. Company names in the examples are made up; where details of a rule or of Codal’s menus are uncertain, they are marked “(please check)”. Dr. Khosravani did not make or endorse this app; the “In Dr. Khosravani’s words” boxes are his public statements, translated from Persian, with their sources.
